column1: # Arabic (ar) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet), or `preview` for the Design tab's tiles
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Translations are written in logical order; the catalog is put into right-to-left display order
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.

column3: في «التطبيقات الافتراضية»، اختر WordCraft لأنواع المستندات التي تريده أن يفتحها.

column2: Make WordCraft the default for Word documents…
Opens .docx, .doc, .rtf and .odt files and Word templates with WordCraft from now on.
column3: يفتح ملفات .docx و.doc و.rtf و.odt وقوالب Word بـWordCraft من الآن فصاعدًا.

column2: Opens Settings › Default apps, where you choose WordCraft for .docx and the other document types.
column3: يفتح «الإعدادات › التطبيقات الافتراضية»، حيث تختار WordCraft لـ.docx وأنواع المستندات الأخرى.

column2: To open Word documents with WordCraft by default: select one in Finder, choose File › Get Info, pick WordCraft under Open with, then click Change All.
column3: لفتح مستندات Word بـWordCraft افتراضيًّا: حدّد واحدًا في Finder، واختر «ملف › معلومات»، واختر WordCraft ضمن «فتح باستخدام»، ثم انقر «تغيير الكل».

column2: WordCraft is now the default app for Word documents.
column3: أصبح WordCraft التطبيق الافتراضي لمستندات Word.
